instruction: A candid documentary medium shot captures a quiet moment outdoors. On the left, the woman in the pink shirt (R1) stands holding a wooden bat, looking forward. On the right, the man in the patterned shirt (R3), wearing glasses, stands behind her, carefully tying a peach bandana over her eyes as a blindfold. The background is a soft-focus green garden. Natural daylight softly illuminates the scene, creating a calm and focused atmosphere as they prepare for the game.
